title: Coins paired with tokenized stocks
summary: Coins from launchpads and projects that tie memecoins to tokenized stocks. STONK (StonkFun) says "Launch tokens / Backed by stocks", and @LaunchOnSF posted on 2026-10-16 that coins can now be launched paired with $MUSK4, a basket of TSLA, SPCX, NEURALINK and DOGE (e3:4). XSTOK says it lets users launch and trade tokens paired with stocks; @xstokfun posted on 2026-10-16 that xstok is open and pairs a coin with any stock on Raydium or Meteora (e3:3), and its pool was created about 14 hours before discovery. OTC says "Over-The-Counter Desks, earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", and @otc_labs posts daily revenue and the volume "across coins" ($98.33M on 2026-10-16, its own figure, e2:3). GTA VI (GTA6, StonkFun) says holders earn $TTWO stock by airdrop; a 2026-10-15 trader post counts 360K+ wallets receiving $31M of tokenized-stock rewards from Solana memecoins (e3:4). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, stock holdings and volumes are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. The Robinhood Chain stock-token coins (BORRO, IRIDIUS) and the AI-stocks meme BUBBLE are not counted. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

title: Ansem pump-wallet selloff coins
summary: Coins tied to the sale of $ANSEM from the Pump.fun wallet of the trader Ansem (@blknoiz06). On 2026-11-24 at 09:39 UTC Lookonchain posted that Ansem "appears to be dumping his holdings" of $ANSEM, down 60% in an hour; at 10:50 UTC Coin Bureau reported that wallets linked to him sold 70.79 million ANSEM for $1.25M and sent the proceeds to an Arbitrum wallet. At 10:59 UTC Ansem posted that his "pump wallet is hacked", which he believes came from unauthorized access to his Bullpen profile. Other posts dispute the hack claim, citing on-chain links to wallets he had funded. Three Pump.fun coins are members: The Black Bull (ANSEM, 9cRCn9...), the coin that was sold, whose pool opened on 2026-06-16 and whose description says 65% of its supply was sent to Ansem's wallet; The White Bull (DUVAL), whose description says "Euris has elected the new leader after Ansem is now gone!" and whose pool opened at 10:11 UTC on 2026-11-24; and a second The Black Bull (ANSEM, DD23R2...), which copies the original's name and ticker and opened at 09:14 UTC that day, during the selling. The hack is Ansem's claim and is not verified here; none of the new coins is shown to be connected to him. Measured: three coins across all their pools.

Forty-eight coins are members, thirty-five of them collected; each has GTA, GTA VI or a GTA VI place, character or in-game brand in its name or description: WASTED ("the iconic GTA death screen"), GTA6CAT, GTA Dollars, Ah shit, here we go again., gtacoin (LaunchLab), Macca The Gator ("GTA 6 Mascot"), State of Leonida and The State of Leonida, Peekhole ("a parody of OnlyFans inside GTA 6"), GTA memes, Jason Duval (it says holders earn $TTWO stock, which is not verified here), Rocco, EEAGLE, Doug The Frog, Jason & Lucia (it says it is unofficial), Official Grand Theft Auto VI (nothing shows it is official), GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency ("not affiliated with any game"), WANTED, Here We Go Again, and Bawsaq and a Vice City Index coin, named for BAWSAQ, the games' fictional stock exchange. On and after release day, coins named for other in-game things joined: five Apocrycoin coins ("Seen in game overheard on a boat mission"; posts of 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-20 say Apocrycoin is a cryptocurrency mentioned in a mission), two Founder coins ("The exchange for GTA VI crypto"; posts say they started from a "Fundador" badge seen in a DacityCoin screenshot), buckme and BuckMe Coin ("the Cash App of GTA 6"), named for BuckMe, the bank app posts call GTA VI's parody of Cash App (the buckme pool opened on 2026-10-08), PIPI ("PIPI the first meme coin in GTA found"; posts dispute whether an in-game PIPI ad is real), two Cool Dog coins ("the dog that saves every player in GTA6"; "Loosy, jet-ski dog in GTA VI"), and with them GTA Season, VICE 6 ("Vice VI | November 19"), OFFICIALGTA (Jason and Lucia; nothing shows it is official), Hugh Johnson ("one of the standout recurring memes of GTA VI's Snapmatic world") and Grand Theft Crew (StonkFun; "a GTA-inspired memecoin"). On 2026-11-22 two more joined: Leonida (LEONIDA), named for the game's state (pool opened 2026-11-22 03:44 UTC; posts say a GTA 6 PC recomp project shares the name), and GTV ("Get paid per view on your GTA 6 clips", pool opened on release day, 2026-11-19 02:20 UTC; the payout claim is the coin's own). Of the collected coins, all but Grand Theft Crew (StonkFun) are on Pump.fun. Dates from Codex: the GTA6CAT and GTA memes pools opened in late August 2026, buckme and several others in October, VICE 6 on 2026-11-13 and most others between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-20, so most launched ahead of the release on its hype. Archived (under $1,000 of 24h volume on two consecutive observations; memberships stay open): Mission Passed, GRAND THEFT CRYPTO, Cyber Dacity Coin, Vice City Bawsaq, the Meteora DBC Vice City Index, Leonida Games, Grand Theft Anthropic and, on 2026-11-21, EEAGLE, Jason & Lucia, GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency and the Meteora DBC apocrycoin, and, on 2026-11-22, gtacoin (LaunchLab). Coins named for the in-game DacityCoin/AudaCity brand are a separate narrative (GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins). The in-game references are as posts describe them and were not checked here; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
